result.topic_en: Heavily corrected draft of the preface to Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen'. It names the method used (from his dissertation and three preceding papers) and gives the history of when the sections were found and when he lectured on them (Göttingen, Michaelis 1855 to Michaelis 1856).
